key_provisions_or_claims: Article 204 of the Polish Criminal Code does not cover facilitating or profiting from prostitution by humanoid robots.
De lege lata, a humanoid robot cannot be criminally liable for harming a user.
Criminal liability of manufacturers or users is not ruled out.
As robots become more autonomous, liability of producers/users becomes less justifiable.
AI liability analogous to criminal liability of legal persons may become relevant; law reform is suggested.
annotation.summary_en: Legal-doctrinal article analysing whether Polish Criminal Code Article 204 covers exploitation of prostitution by humanoid robots and criminal liability for harm they cause. It finds gaps in current law, notes manufacturer/user liability, and suggests future AI liability akin to that of legal persons.
